blocks.title: The auditor
blocks.text: Opinion not modified (a clean opinion), in the consolidated and standalone reports.

blocks.title: Contingent liabilities
blocks.text: Claims not acknowledged as debt: ₹78.1 crore at 31 March 2026, ₹19.5 crore a year earlier. That is 9% of FY26 profit. These are claims made on the company that it has not accepted as owed.
